description: Contract key-terms extractor — Pull the key commercial terms out of a contract or terms page: parties, effective date, term, renewal and non-renewal notice, termination rights, payment terms, fees, late fees, price increases, liability cap, indemnification, warranty, governing law, venue, assignment, confidentiality, data protection, IP ownership, exclusivity, non-compete, insurance, audit rights, force majeure. Each term has a plain-English value and an exact quote verified offline, plus missing terms and red flags (auto-renewal, no liability cap, no exit right). Params: text= (contract text, up to 30k chars) or url= (public page). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. This Services Agreement is effective January 1, 2026 between Acme Corp (Customer) and Beta LLC (Provider). The initial term is 12 months and renews automatically for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives 60 days written notice. Customer shall pay invoices within 30 days. Provider's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the prior 12 months. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.
